payload.ddl: CREATE TABLE chatbot_ncdc_offices_private ( id TEXT, ncdcid TEXT, /* NCDCID of the Office */ office_type_name TEXT, /* Type of the Office */ name_of_office TEXT, /* Name of the Office */ phone_number TEXT, /* Phone Number of the Office */ email TEXT, /* Email of the Office */ full_address TEXT, /* Full Address of the Office */ state_name TEXT, /* Name of the State/UT where the Office is located */ district_name TEXT, /* Name of the District where the Office is located */ pin_code TEXT, /* Pin Code of the Office */ controller_name TEXT, /* Name of the Controller of the Office */ controller_designation_name TEXT, /* Designation of the Controller of the Office */ controller_email TEXT, /* Email of the Controller of the Office */ controller_phone_number TEXT, /* Phone Number of the Controller of the Office */ area_sq_ft TEXT, /* Area of the Office in Square Feet */ geometry_type TEXT, /* Type of the Office Geometry (Polygon or Point) */ ownership_name TEXT, /* Type of Ownership of the Office (Owned, Rented) */ specialization TEXT, /* Specialization of the Office (Financial/Training) */ latitude TEXT, /* Latitude of the Office */ longitude TEXT, /* Longitude of the Office */ status TEXT, /* Status of the Office (1=Active, 0=Inactive) */ is_approved TEXT /* Approval status of the Office */ );
